definitions.name: Strictly Typed
definitions.description: tsc strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess is clean from P2 on.
definitions.criteria: `tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess` exits 0 in every node project p[2-9]-*

definitions.name: Union Jack
definitions.description: Discriminated union with an exhaustive never check (>=3 arms).
definitions.criteria: a node domain source file has a discriminated union with >=3 variants AND a `: never` exhaustiveness assignment in its switch default, and `tsc --noEmit` exits 0

definitions.name: No Floating Money
definitions.description: P1 money vectors green with no number arithmetic on amounts.
definitions.criteria: `verify: vectors p1 money-rounding` exits 0 for node AND no `number`-typed amount field or arithmetic on amounts in the P1 domain (grep for Money amount typed number returns 0 matches)

definitions.name: Loop Whisperer
definitions.description: CPU-bound use case offloaded to a worker thread, benchmark committed.
definitions.criteria: a node project uses node:worker_threads for a CPU-bound use case AND a benchmark report file comparing before/after is committed under that project
